units: <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 107:1">Sifré Num. 107</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 15:18">Num. XV, 18</cite>) <he>אחר י׳ וישיבה וכ׳</he> the text means after conquering and settling in the land (proving from <cite ref="Deuteronomy 11:31">Deut. XI, 31</cite>); <cite ref="Kiddushin 37b:8">Kidd. 37ᵇ</cite>.
Ib. 37ᵃ מושב לאחר י׳ וישיבה משמע the word dwelling (e.g.
<cite ref="Leviticus 23:14">Lev. XXIII, 14</cite>) means after conquest &c. Ib. 38ᵃ; a. fr.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:12">Ab. II, 12</cite> <he>שאינה י׳ לך</he> for it (the knowledge of the Law) does not come to thee by inheritance (without toil).
<cite ref="Nedarim 81a:3">Ned. 81ᵃ</cite> that it may not be said <he>י׳ היא להם</he> scholarship comes to them by inheritance.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 345:2">Sifré Deut. 345</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 33:4">Deut. XXXIII, 4</cite>) <he>שומע אני י׳ לבני מלכים וכ׳</he> I might understand, it is an inheritance of the sons of the nobles &c.

<cite ref="Deuteronomy 33:4">Ib.</cite> <he>לִירוּשָּׁתִי אני חוזר</he> I am returning to my own heirloom; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 33:7">Ex. R. s. 33</cite> <he>לִירוּשַּׁת אבותי</he> to my paternal heirloom.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 110b:2">B. Bath. 110ᵇ</cite> <he>בת י׳</he> having the right of inheritance.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 113b:2">Ib. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>י׳ ראשונה</he> the first succession (direct heirs, children &c.); <he>י׳ שנייה</he> indirect heirs (brothers &c.); a. v. fr.
